summary.text: Dara Torre is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-2 District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has worked as a program coordinator with the Regulatory Assistance Project.

paragraphs.text: Dara Torre lives in Vermont and earned a bachelor's degree in history, with a minor in government, from Oberlin College.
She also holds a certificate in nonprofit management from Marlboro College and a certificate in climate change and health from the Yale School of Public Health.
Her career experience includes working as a U.S. program coordinator with the Regulatory Assistance Project and as an administrator with the Colorado AIDS Clinical Trials Unit.
Torre began volunteering as Moretown's energy coordinator, as a Central Vermont Regional Planning Commission board member and as a Mad River Valley Rotary member.
She assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
